reason: Normalization mode 0 scales the maximum magnitude to 32760. Applying an unchanged raw-vector absolute bound to these scaled values would change the accuracy requirement. Keep the frozen raw BERT bound and propagate it through this known scaling.
formula: Let M=max(abs(native_raw)), E=a+r*M. For y=32760*x/M, bound |delta y| by 32760*a/(M-E) + abs(y)*((r*M+E)/(M-E)+4*f32_epsilon). All metadata remains exact.
additional_gate: Direct normalization of the same frozen native raw vectors is checked independently within two f32 ULPs on portable targets and bit for bit on Windows MSVC x64. End-to-end Windows values and base64 remain exact.
